intent: Make the accepted UC04-W0 Git LFS evidence verifier representation-independent across source archives, skip-smudge checkouts, and hydrated GitHub Actions checkouts.
current_behavior: UC04-W0 accepts only pointer text in the working tree, so a valid actions/checkout LFS-hydrated tree fails before W1B verification begins.
desired_behavior: Use the Git HEAD blob as the canonical pointer when available and accept either matching pointer text or a hydrated object whose size and SHA-256 match that pointer.
scope: bounded release-hash amendment for the corrected verifier
pointer, hydrated-object, and corruption regression tests
non_goals: download missing historical LFS blobs into source archives
change market data or trading semantics
modify MQL5 consumers or runtime behavior
grant implementation, cutover, order, or capital authority
preserved_invariants: the four historical paths remain the W0 LFS blocker inventory
the original UC04-W0 patch hash ledger is unchanged
invalid pointer metadata and corrupted hydrated bytes fail closed
W0, W1A, W1B, UC-03, and engineering-policy gates remain mandatory
rollback_strategy: Before commit restore the W0 verifier from HEAD and remove the exact added paths; after commit use a normal git revert commit.
residual_risks: The corrected behavior must still be confirmed by a new GitHub Actions run after the commit is pushed.
The complete repository test suite remains unclaimed because the source archive still contains four historical LFS pointers without blobs.
